title: Calacatta Kitchen with Walnut Island
scope: Removed the wall between kitchen and family room, new layout with a 10-foot walnut island, full-height Calacatta quartz backsplash, paneled appliances.
materials: Calacatta quartz, rift-cut walnut, brushed brass hardware, wide-plank white oak
summary: A closed 1970s kitchen opened to the family room, centered on a 10-foot walnut island.
description: This Palatine kitchen was closed off from the family room by a load-bearing wall. We replaced the wall with a flush beam, moved the sink to a new 10-foot walnut island, and ran Calacatta quartz from the counters up the full backsplash. Paneled refrigerator and dishwasher keep the cabinet run clean, and brushed brass hardware ties the island to the lighting. The project was permitted through the Village of Palatine and took 8 weeks on site.

title: Primary Bath with Green Zellige Shower
scope: Tub removed for a curbless walk-in shower, heated floor, double vanity.
materials: Handmade zellige tile, terrazzo floor, Schluter waterproofing
summary: Tub out, curbless zellige shower in, with a heated terrazzo-look floor.
description: The owners wanted the dated tub and fiberglass surround gone. We recessed the subfloor for a curbless shower, waterproofed with Schluter Kerdi, and tiled the walls in handmade green zellige. A heated floor and a 72-inch double vanity finished the room in 4 weeks.

title: Nero Marble Powder Room
scope: Floating stone vanity, wall-mounted faucet, full-height marble wall.
materials: Nero marble, plaster walls, brass fixtures
summary: A small room made dramatic with a full-height Nero marble wall.
description: A two-week powder room remodel in Inverness built around one full-height wall of Nero marble, a floating stone vanity and a wall-mounted brass faucet.

title: Terrazzo Hall Bath
scope: New tub and tile surround, terrazzo floor, new vanity and lighting.
materials: Terrazzo porcelain, white ceramic wall tile
summary: A kids' hall bath rebuilt for durability with terrazzo tile.
description: A hard-working hall bath rebuilt with terrazzo porcelain floors, a new cast iron tub and an easy-clean tile surround.

title: Basement with Walnut Wet Bar
scope: Full basement finish with wet bar, media wall and egress window.
summary: An unfinished basement turned into a media room with a walnut wet bar.
description: A full basement finish with framing, insulation, an egress window, a walnut wet bar and a media wall.

title: Plaster Hood White Kitchen
scope: New cabinets, plaster range hood, quartz counters, new lighting plan.
materials: Venetian plaster, quartz, painted maple cabinets
summary: A bright kitchen refresh anchored by a custom plaster range hood.
description: New painted cabinetry, a custom plaster range hood and a new lighting plan in a 6-week Rolling Meadows kitchen remodel.
